independentPropertyVariance.ts(6,1): error TS2367: This comparison appears to be unintentional because the types '{ a: 1; b: string }' and '{ a: number; b: "a" }' have no overlap.


==== independentPropertyVariance.ts (1 errors) ====
    // Verify that properties can vary independently in comparable relationship
    
    declare const x: { a: 1, b: string };
    declare const y: { a: number, b: 'a' };
    
    x === y;
    ~~~~~~~
!!! error TS2367: This comparison appears to be unintentional because the types '{ a: 1; b: string }' and '{ a: number; b: "a" }' have no overlap.
